name: Sakuraba Natsuki
source:
“Please stop it! Even though I tried so hard not to remember!”

Fate x Unfortunate Constitution. 

A second year high-school student at Kirigaya Private Academy.
For some reason, this pityful heroine keeps getting attraction from dangerous men.

As a member of health committee , she's devoted on providing support & also known for her affection toward animals which earned as kind-hearted person. 

Is her kindness bringing some misfortunes? Or....
